sources.title: Building Safety Levy: Guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Current guidance sets the levy framework, rates, developer and local-authority processes and exemptions; it is not candidate-specific liability evidence.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Section 1: Introduction
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The levy is due to come into effect on 1 October 2026 for relevant new applications, subject to exemptions; this future date is retained and not treated as current liability before then.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Section 2: Levy rates and calculations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Rates vary by local authority and previously developed land can receive a discounted rate where the prescribed redline test is met; a borough rate alone does not establish liability.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Section 3: Advice for developers of residential buildings
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Developer guidance ties levy information and payment to building-control routes, commencement information, chargeable floorspace and exemptions; exact scheme facts are required.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Section 4: Advice for local authorities
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Local authorities act as collecting authorities and must process prescribed levy information; collection duties do not imply a sample parcel has a chargeable development.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Section 5: Advice for Registered Building Control Approvers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: RBCAs have information and notification responsibilities for relevant initial notices; an RBCA route is not assumed for any sample parcel.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Annex A: process maps
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Process maps illustrate levy information, payment and completion-certificate dependencies across building-control routes; they are illustrative rather than candidate records.

sources.title: Building Safety Levy - Annex C: methodology note
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The methodology explains per-square-metre rate setting and the planned revenue profile; methodology cannot substitute for exact candidate floorspace, use, date and exemption facts.
